text:
Tasha: hey team — quick onboarding question: I'm oncall starting Mon. what should I focus on this week to be ready for pagers?
Alex: welcome! :tada: primary things: runbooks, escalation path, and access to the alert dashboard.
Maria: +1. Check the runbooks in /docs/runbooks (search 'oncall'). there's a 'first 24h' checklist.
Jordan: also ping me if you can't access the pager rota. sometimes new hires miss the oncall group invite.
Tasha: I don't see the rota link. can someone post it?
Alex: here — https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-rotation. rota is also in the #eng-oncall pinned messages.
Sam: for hands-on practice, we do a simulated alert on staging every Friday. sign up for a shadow slot with me: /signup oncall-shadow.
Tasha: thanks — how strict is the escalation? if an alert is noisy, should I escalate or notify engineering directly?
Maria: If the alert impacts customer-facing latency or errors, escalate immediately. For noisy/duplicate alerts, add a note on the alert and mute only after confirming it's noisy.
Jordan: Escalation chain: oncall -> svc-owner -> oncall-lead -> pager-duty-manager. If unsure, escalate early and we can triage.
SRE-Bot: automatic reminder: new_oncall_account_created for Tasha. Please verify MFA and PagerDuty access: https://pd.redwood/signup
Tasha: I couldn't finish PD signup due to MFA error (browser prompt not showing). anyone seen that?
Alex: try incognito or a different browser. if it still fails, file a ticket to eng-identity and tag @Maria — they usually fix SSO mapping.
Maria: I can look after this meeting. @Tasha DM me your employee id.
Sam: runbooks to practice: 'restore-cache', 'rotate-service-keys', 'fallback-to-readonly'. each has a small checklist and a test script.
Tasha: do we have any oncall training sessions or shadowing recommended?
Sam: yes — 2hr oncall bootcamp Thursday 10am weekly. we cover common incidents, runbook walkthroughs, and how to signal for help.
Jordan: also watch the short ops-play video (10m) in the onboarding playlist. helps a lot.
Tasha: perfect. last q: how do I mark handoff at end of shift?
Alex: use the /handoff command in #eng-oncall and paste current incidents + what you did. example:
```
/handoff
Incidents: none
Notes: restarted cache leader, monitoring spacedown
```
Tasha: awesome — thanks everyone! I'll DM Maria about SSO and sign up for a shadow slot with Sam. :slightly_smiling_face:
Maria: welcome aboard again — we'll make the first week smooth.
SRE-Bot: scheduled: oncall-bootcamp Thursday 10:00 (invite sent).
Sam: ping if you want to join an extra shadow session this week.
Tasha: will do, thanks :)
